summary: Prepare to audit ISO 37301 compliance management systems with PECB Lead Auditor training, practical case studies, and structured exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who audit, lead, support, or prepare for audits of compliance management systems against ISO 37301.
prerequisites: To participate, you need a fundamental understanding of ISO 37301 requirements, or the ISO 19600 guidelines, for a CMS, together with comprehensive knowledge of audit principles. To hold the PECB Certified ISO 37301 Lead Auditor credential, you must pass the exam or an equivalent exam, have five years of professional experience including two years in compliance management, complete at least 300 hours of audit activities, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics.
